FICA savings on the FSA contribution are the 7.65% employee share (IRC §3101(a) 6.2% + §3101(b)(1) 1.45%) with NO OASDI wage-base cap ($184,500 for 2026) and NO 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax. Marginal federal and state rates are caller inputs, not computed from tax tables. Not modelled: the §129(b) earned-income limit on the exclusion, the §129(a)(2)(B) excess inclusion, §129(c) related providers, §21(e) household and joint-return rules (MFS is flagged, not zeroed), plan discrimination tests (§129(d)), employer discounts, and state conformity. The optimum is searched on $250 grid steps and is never bounded by actual expenses, exactly as the source page does; both are flagged. Educational decision support, not tax advice. Money is float USD exactly as the source computes it; nothing rounds.
